subject: Renewal jeopardy — benchmark request and term trade
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@equinox.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@equinox.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal jeopardy — exploring alternatives ahead of April renewal

Hi Mina / Ben,

Quick heads up — our contract with Redwood comes up for renewal mid-April and the execs have asked us to run a short side-by-side with a competitor (two-week bakeoff). Performance and unit cost are the primary drivers; they also want to validate cold-start and peak throughput behavior.

Before we start a formal bakeoff we wanted two things from you:
- A lightweight benchmark plan we can run (what data you need, expected run shape, and what metrics you provide)
- Any short-term term/commitment options you could offer if the results land in your favor (we're looking at a 12–18 month committed uplift if pricing/perf works out)

Sophie is leading procurement on our side (cc'd). Please send the benchmark plan and an outline of a capacity/term trade you could consider. We're on a tight cadence — execs want results in ~10 business days.

Thanks,
Liam
Head of ML Infrastructure
Equinox AI

Attachments: none
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@equinox.ai>, Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@equinox.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal jeopardy — exploring alternatives ahead of April renewal

Hi Liam / Sophie — thanks for the heads up and for looping us in. We take these bakeoffs seriously and want to make this as low-friction as possible for your team. High-level plan below; attaching a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out timeline/owners and the data we need.

Proposed benchmark run (2–3 days of execution + 3–4 days of analysis):
- Workload: 50k inference requests/day, 95th-p75 mix to match your current distribution (please confirm sample traces)
- Profiles: cold-start (first request after idle), steady-state throughput, peak ramp (simulate 5x burst for 5 min)
- Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency (token-level), throughput (tokens/sec), GPU utilization, memory/KV-cache hit rate, per-token cost estimate under Redwood serving configuration
- Deliverables: raw traces, processed comparison dashboard, verification checklist, mitigation suggestions if performance gap found

What we need from you:
- A 24–48 hour sample of your current request traces (anonymized) or a representative script
- Confirmation of the target model size and max sequence length for the run
- Point-of-contact for engineering who can authorize traffic shaping during the run

Short-term commercial options we can bring to the execs quickly:
- 12-month committed uplift at 15% off hosted list pricing for committed tokens with a 30% capacity uplift clause for 6 months
- Commitment to a faster escalation SLA (priority capacity routing) during the two-week window to ensure performance parity

If that looks reasonable I can schedule a technical kickoff tomorrow with Ben (Solutions) and Marissa (CS) to walk the team through the plan.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-equinox.xlsx
From: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@equinox.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@equinox.ai>, procurement@equinox.ai
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 14:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal jeopardy — exploring alternatives ahead of April renewal

Thanks Mina — the MAP helps. We can provide anonymized traces by EOD tomorrow and our model profile is: 13B decoder-only, max_seq=1024, average prompt length ~120 tokens.

Two quick asks from our side:
1) Procurement wants a clear term illustration: if we sign a 12-month uplift at the proposed 15% discount, what are the cancellation/overage terms? (procurement cc'd)
2) Our infra team will upload a short set of latency samples and logs from last week's peak to the MAP folder — they want the bakeoff to include a cold-start scenario with warm/idle windows of 30+ minutes. I'm attaching a small ZIP with sample logs.

We can do a technical kickoff on Apr 2 at 10:00am PT. Can your engineer join?

Sophie
Director, Procurement
Equinox AI

Attachments: equinox-latency-sample-logs.zip
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@equinox.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@equinox.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procurement@equinox.ai
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal jeopardy — exploring alternatives ahead of April renewal

Sophie / Liam — appreciate the quick turnaround with traces and the logs. I joined the kickoff this morning and captured a few immediate takeaways; attaching our preliminary benchmark report and a checklist for the two-week run. Highlights:

- Based on the trace profile, we can reproduce the cold-start behavior (30+ min idle) and the 5x burst scenario in our Redwood test harness.
- Early sims show median token latency parity and better CPU-side batching efficiency under our recommended config; we'll validate p95/p99 in the run.
- For the commercial ask: the 15% discount can be applied to a 12-month committed uplift with the following simple terms:
  * Cancellation: 60-day exit right after 90 days with proportional usage reconciliation
  * Overage: billed at list price for any usage beyond committed tokens during the contract term
  * Early performance remediation: Redwood will provide an ops allocation for any verified SLO miss during the first 6 months (priority routing + dedicated runbooks)

Next steps (action items):
1) Equinox to upload full two-day trace sample to the MAP folder (we received the sample zip; need the traces) — HS-34567 is the MAP tracker.
2) Redwood will run the two-week bakeoff in a dedicated bucket with isolated capacity starting Apr 5 — report back by Apr 12.
3) If results favor Redwood, Mina will send a concise commercial term sheet and a DocuSign link for signature.

I attached the preliminary report (tech highlights) and the test checklist. We'll be running the full job in an isolated environment and will share the dashboard link as soon as it's live.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: redwood-benchmark-report-q1-2027.pdf
